onboarding_sessions_kind_columns_check.name: onboarding_sessions_kind_columns_check
onboarding_sessions_kind_columns_check.value: ("onboarding_sessions"."kind" = 'declarant' and "onboarding_sessions"."tenant" is not null and "onboarding_sessions"."roster_record_id" is not null and "onboarding_sessions"."document_kind" is null) or ("onboarding_sessions"."kind" = 'applicant' and "onboarding_sessions"."tenant" is null and "onboarding_sessions"."roster_record_id" is null and "onboarding_sessions"."document_kind" in ('national-id', 'passport') and "onboarding_sessions"."document_number" is not null and ("onboarding_sessions"."document_kind" = 'passport') = ("onboarding_sessions"."document_country" is not null) and "onboarding_sessions"."surname" is not null and "onboarding_sessions"."first_name" is not null)

onboarding_sessions_email_source_check.name: onboarding_sessions_email_source_check
onboarding_sessions_email_source_check.value: ("onboarding_sessions"."email" is null) = ("onboarding_sessions"."email_source" is null) and ("onboarding_sessions"."email_source" is null or "onboarding_sessions"."email_source" in ('roster', 'declarant', 'applicant'))

onboarding_sessions_phone_source_check.name: onboarding_sessions_phone_source_check
onboarding_sessions_phone_source_check.value: ("onboarding_sessions"."phone" is null) = ("onboarding_sessions"."phone_source" is null) and ("onboarding_sessions"."phone_source" is null or "onboarding_sessions"."phone_source" in ('roster', 'declarant', 'applicant'))

persons_declarant_identity_check.name: persons_declarant_identity_check
persons_declarant_identity_check.value: "persons"."kind" <> 'declarant' or ("persons"."national_id" is not null and "persons"."ofr" is not null)

persons_applicant_identity_check.name: persons_applicant_identity_check
persons_applicant_identity_check.value: "persons"."kind" <> 'applicant' or ("persons"."ofr" is null and "persons"."identity_status" is not null and ("persons"."national_id" is null) <> ("persons"."passport_number" is null) and ("persons"."passport_number" is null) = ("persons"."passport_country" is null))

persons_applicant_only_check.name: persons_applicant_only_check
persons_applicant_only_check.value: "persons"."kind" = 'applicant' or ("persons"."passport_number" is null and "persons"."passport_country" is null and "persons"."identity_status" is null)

persons_identity_verified_check.name: persons_identity_verified_check
persons_identity_verified_check.value: "persons"."identity_status" is null or ("persons"."identity_status" = 'verified') = ("persons"."identity_verified_at" is not null)
